subject: Intro: Redwood demo request — use case & timing
messages:
From: Samantha Liu <samantha@clearmart.com>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Interested in Redwood — quick demo request

Hi Camila,

I signed up through your self-serve flow this morning and requested a demo. We're evaluating inference platforms for our personalization pipeline at ClearMart and would love a short walkthrough next week. High-level: retail personalization, real-time inference at edge-proxy, aiming for lower latency and cost than our current setup.

Can you share what you typically cover in a 30-minute demo and what information you need from us ahead of time? Also happy to propose times — we are ET-based.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Liu | Head of AI | ClearMart
Phone: +1 415 555 0137
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha@clearmart.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood — quick demo request

Hi Samantha — great to meet you and thanks for signing up. I'm Camila on the inbound SDR team; happy to coordinate the demo.

Quick answers: our 30-minute demo typically covers:
- 10m: high-level product map (hosted/dedicated/private)
- 10m: how we handle low-latency serving + KV cache and smart routing
- 10m: Q&A and next steps (pricing/POs/Demo env)

Before the session it helps if you can share:
- primary use case and where Redwood would sit in your stack
- expected request volume (RPS or monthly tokens) and typical sequence lengths
- timeline for pilot/prod (months) and any compliance needs (VPC, SOC2)
- who should join (engineering/infra/PO)

I attached a short pre-demo questionnaire that usually speeds things up — 2 minutes to fill. [Attachment: pre-demo-questionnaire.pdf (pdf, 12KB)]

If it helps, pick a 30-min slot here: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-30m (we default to PT/ET options). Proposed windows I can offer next week (ET):
- Tue 2026-09-01 11:00–11:30 ET
- Wed 2026-09-02 15:00–15:30 ET

Cc-ing Aditya (our AE) for visibility; he can join the call if you'd like a deeper pricing discussion.

—
Camila Reyes | Senior SDR | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | +1 650 555 0112

Cc: Carlos Kim <c.kim@clearmart.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:30:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood — quick demo request

Thanks Camila — questionnaire completed (answers below). I'll loop in Carlos (platform lead) — he's CC'd.

Answers:
- Use case: personalization + search re-ranking for web and API (real-time user sessions + batched offline scoring).
- Volume: pilot ~50k tokens/day; prod target ~3–4M tokens/day. Expected peak RPS ~40–60 for session scoring.
- Sequence lengths: typically 64–128 tokens per request, occasional long contexts (~512) for complex sessions.
- Timeline: pilot in ~6–8 weeks, production in Q1 2027.
- Compliance: we need VPC option and audit logs; SOC2 is a plus.

Attendees: me + Carlos (cc), and possibly one infra engineer (TBD). ET is fine.

For the times you suggested, Wed 2026-09-02 15:00 ET works best for us.

Samantha
